story: MA129 Music Therapy - Day 6 (concert day at the Berkeley)
reel: BROLL_REEL (manifest row order, reelStart = cumulative duration_seconds)

clips.shots: 30%: wide on audience of ~15 seniors (mostly women) seated on stacking chairs in the activity room, warm wood floor, window light behind. 70%: same setup, heads turned slightly toward the performance area; same framing.

30% and 70%: lounge interior - gray-haired woman in floral top laughing/talking with bald man in bright floral shirt, but a CREW CAMERA OPERATOR with shoulder rig fills the right third of frame at both marks.
clips.notes: Crew visible: second camera operator and rig clearly in shot in both frames. Also very short (2.3s).

clips.shots: 30%: close-up of green 'The Berkeley' leaf-logo lettering mounted on white exterior wall. 70%: same sign, slightly different angle (slow move).
30%: exterior lawn sign 'The Berkeley - Gracious Independent Retirement Living' with two wooden benches, trees and pathway behind. 70%: essentially the same framing (long static/slow shot).
clips.notes: Prime establisher; 50s long, plenty of handle.

clips.shots: 30%: building entrance '35', man in blue jacket walking toward doors, half hidden behind white column; white flowering shrub right. 70%: clean close-up of a single white five-petal wild rose on a green shrub.
clips.notes: At 30% subject is blocked by the column mid-move; the 70% flower CU is the keeper - nice echo of the white floral brooches.

clips.shots: 30% and 70%: white spirea blossom clusters on green shrub in front of a dark window; same framing.
clips.notes: Image is fine but the clip is only 1.3s - too short for most cutaways.

clips.shots: 30%: heavily defocused foliage/white flowers in front of a window with wicker chair behind glass - focus not landed. 70%: tilted high-angle on bright green leaves, part of an unresolved camera move, soft.
clips.notes: Both sampled frames are soft/mid-move; there may be a settled section elsewhere in the 34s, but as sampled it does not cut.

clips.shots: 30%: sharp close-up of magenta geranium cluster with small white flowers, creamy green bokeh. 70%: same flower bed but focus has drifted - foreground blooms soft.
clips.notes: Front portion (around 30%) is the usable part; back half goes soft.

clips.shots: 30% and 70%: garden detail - two rocks painted as ladybugs sitting in dark soil with small seedlings; same framing, slight angle change.
clips.notes: Charming character detail for the residence gardens.

clips.shots: 30% and 70%: exterior - empty wooden bench on stone legs beside curving wet walkway along the residence, flower beds and lamp post; same framing.

30%: from behind two seated gray-haired audience members - tablet music stands set against white cabinet doors, ukulele leaning, fan at left (pre-show setup). 70%: closer on three tablet/music stands with dark sparkly scarves draped and ukuleles hung on the stands, fire extinguisher right.
clips.notes: Good setup/anticipation coverage of the band's tablet stands and ukes before the show.

clips.shots: 30%: over-the-shoulder rear view of white-haired women seated in the audience, bright window beyond. 70%: similar rear view, more residents in blue tops, butterfly wall decor visible.
30%: from the back of the room - four empty tablet music stands lined up against white cabinets, audience heads in foreground waiting. 70%: same, slightly wider/looser.
clips.notes: Nice anticipation shot: stage set, crowd waiting.

clips.shots: 30%: room wide - seniors seated, tablet stands and a ukulele against the cabinets, butterfly art on walls. 70%: bald man with earring in vivid floral shirt standing and gesturing animatedly beside a seated older man in plaid, window behind.
clips.notes: Long 2m16s clip covering the room plus the floral-shirt gentleman (likely the MC/host) working the crowd; frames differ - both marks usable.

clips.shots: 30% and 70%: close-up of round gold 'Royal Oak Dining Room' sign with oak-tree emblem, mounted on interior bracket; slight angle change.
30% and 70%: interior wide of the residence lobby - wood-paneled reception desk, landscape painting, Canada flag, glass entry doors; static framing.
30% and 70%: framed impressionist painting (barn with irises/garden) shot through the brass rails of a luggage cart; same framing.
clips.notes: Arty interior detail; floral subject matter fits the theme.

clips.shots: 30%: close-up of white calla lilies in a dried-grass arrangement in front of mirrored oak paneling, shallow focus. 70%: wider on the same arrangement, lobby furniture reflected in the beveled mirrors.
clips.notes: Strong floral motif shot - ties to Neville's brooches.

clips.shots: 30%: the five 'Sixty and Change' performers in matching blue/orange floral shirts plus a sixth woman in black-and-white floral posing for a group photo, white floral brooches pinned on chests, banjolele/ukulele resting on a chair in front; a resident in foreground photographs them with a phone. 70%: one performer (brown bob) walks toward camera, white floral brooch prominent, bandmates hugging behind.
clips.notes: Best band coverage in the reel - brooches clearly visible; phone photographer is a resident, not crew.

clips.shots: 30%: fully defocused - performers in floral shirts are soft blobs behind a dark foreground ledge (pre rack-focus). 70%: rack focus landed - yellow/red rose lying sharp on the wood ledge in foreground, band group-hugging soft in background.
clips.notes: Use the back half after the rack focus resolves on the rose; first half is unusably soft. Beautiful story beat: flower foreground, celebration behind.

clips.shots: 30%: patio flower boxes - purple petunias, red geraniums, yellow blooms sharp in foreground, furled green umbrellas and residence windows soft behind. 70%: wider - patio with furled green and blue umbrellas, chairs, and planters across the foreground.
